## Harald Belker

### Tenure

[2004](/wiki/2004) – [2006](/wiki/2006)

**Harald Georg Belker** is a German industrial designer who worked for Mattel from 2004 to 2006 as a design consultant. Born in Krefeld in 1961, Belker is noted for his futuristic automobile designs, such as the [Lexus 2054](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lexus_2054) from the film *[Minority Report](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minority_Report)*, the [Batmobile](/wiki/Batman_%26_Robin_Batmobile) from *[Batman & Robin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Batman_%26_Robin)* and the Hover Car from *[Total Recall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_Recall)*. He currently manages his own design firm, Harald Belker Design and designs vehicles for the movie industry on a part-time basis; he is also noted to have been employed on a contractural basis by Apple, Waymo and Samsung.
